## Service: objects (CUSTOM_OBJECTS API)

Custom objects are completely customizable objects that allow you to store and manage information tailored to your unique business needs. With custom objects, you can create custom fields, establish relationships, and integrate them into workflows, providing flexibility beyond standard objects like Contacts, Opportunities or Companies.

### Create Custom Object
POST /objects/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/objects/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/create-custom-object-schema | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/create-custom-object-schema.md

Allows you to create a custom object schema. To understand objects and records, please have a look at the documentation here : https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-277156/93bf0c2e23177b0

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: objects/schema.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCustomObjectSchemaDTO:
- labels* object - This is what your custom object will be called. These labels will be used to display your custom object on the UI
  - singular* string (e.g. "Pet") - Singular name of the custom object
  - plural* string (e.g. "Pets") - Plural name of the custom object
- key* string (e.g. "custom_objects.pet") - key that would be used to refer the Custom Object internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). 'custom_objects.' would be added as prefix by default
- description string (e.g. "These are non vaccinated pets") - Pet Object`s description
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id
- primaryDisplayPropertyDetails* object - Primary property which will be displayed on the record page
  - key* string (e.g. "custom_objects.pet.name") - key that would be used to refer the custom field internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). 'custom_objects.{{objectKey}}' would be added as prefix by default is not passed
  - name* string (e.g. "Pet name") - Name of the Primary property name which will be displayed on the record page
  - dataType* string (e.g. "TEXT") - Primary property data Type (it can either be TEXT or NUMERICAL type)

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- object object
  - id* string - id of the custom / standard object schema
  - standard* boolean - false in case of custom objects and true in case of standard objects like contacts and opportunities
  - key* string - key that would be used to refer the custom / standard Object internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). For custom objects, 'custom_objects.' would be added as prefix by default
  - labels* object - This is what your custom / standard object will be called. These labels will be used to display your custom object on the UI
    - singular* string - Singular name of the custom object
    - plural* string - Plural name of the custom object
  - description string - Custom / Standard Object Descriptions for example , Pet Object`s description
  - locationId* string - location's id
  - primaryDisplayProperty* string - Primary property for the custom / standard Object. This would be used as primary data when rendering the UI. 'custom_objects.{{object_key}} or business.{{object_key}} (for company)' would be added as prefix by default for all the custom / standard objects
  - dateAdded* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was added
  - dateUpdated* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was last updated
  - type object - Object`s Type

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Create Note
POST /notes/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/notes/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/create-note | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/create-note.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: notes.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Location Id

Request body (required) (application/json) NotesDTO:
- body* string (e.g. "lorem ipsum") - The body content of the note
- relations* object[] (minItems: 1) - Records this note is attached to — e.g. a custom object record, a contact, or a business. At least one relation is required.
  - objectKey string (e.g. "custom_objects.pet") - Object type the note is attached to — a custom object schema key (e.g. "custom_objects.pet"), or a standard object key such as "contact" or "business".
  - recordId string (e.g. "632c34b4c9b7da3358ac9891") - Id of the record to attach the note to. Available on the Record details page under the 3 dots or in the url.
- userId* string (e.g. "TUcmRxWrjqzJS8EjkxNK") - The ID of the user creating the note

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- note object - The note object
  - id string - Unique identifier for the note
  - body string - The body content of the note
  - userId string - The ID of the user who created the note
  - dateAdded string - The date and time when the note was created
  - contactId string - The ID of the contact associated with the note. Present only when the note is attached to a contact — notes on custom object records are linked through `relations`.
  - businessId string - The ID of the business associated with the note. Present only when the note is attached to a business — notes on custom object records are linked through `relations`.
  - title string - The title of the note
  - color string - The color code of the note
  - pinned boolean - Whether the note is pinned
  - attachments object[] - List of attachments associated with the note
    - id string - Unique identifier for the attachment
    - objectKey string - Object type the note is attached to — a custom object schema key (e.g. "custom_objects.pet"), or a standard object key such as "contact" or "business".
    - recordId string - Id of the record to attach the note to. Available on the Record details page under the 3 dots or in the url.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get Object Schema by key / id
GET /objects/{key}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/objects/{key}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/get-object-schema-by-key | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/get-object-schema-by-key.md

Retrieve Object Schema by key or ID. This will return the schema of the custom object, including all its fields and properties. Supported objects include contact, opportunity, business and custom objects.To understand objects and records, please have a look the documentation here : https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-277156/93bf0c2e23177b0

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: objects/schema.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- key* string (e.g. "custom_objects.pet") - key of the custom or standard object. For custom objects, the key must include the prefix “custom_objects.”. This key can be found on the Object Details page under Settings in the UI.

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "632c34b4c9b7da3358ac9891") - location id of the sub account
- fetchProperties string - Fetch Properties , Fetches all the standard / custom fields of the object when set to true

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- object object
  - id* string - id of the custom / standard object schema
  - standard* boolean - false in case of custom objects and true in case of standard objects like contacts and opportunities
  - key* string - key that would be used to refer the custom / standard Object internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). For custom objects, 'custom_objects.' would be added as prefix by default
  - labels* object - This is what your custom / standard object will be called. These labels will be used to display your custom object on the UI
    - singular* string - Singular name of the custom object
    - plural* string - Plural name of the custom object
  - description string - Custom / Standard Object Descriptions for example , Pet Object`s description
  - locationId* string - location's id
  - primaryDisplayProperty* string - Primary property for the custom / standard Object. This would be used as primary data when rendering the UI. 'custom_objects.{{object_key}} or business.{{object_key}} (for company)' would be added as prefix by default for all the custom / standard objects
  - dateAdded* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was added
  - dateUpdated* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was last updated
  - type object - Object`s Type
- cache* boolean - Is the response served from cache
- fields object[]
  - locationId* string - Location Id
  - name string - Field name
  - description string - Description of the field
  - placeholder string - Placeholder text for the field
  - showInForms* boolean - Whether the field should be shown in forms
  - options object[] - Options for the field (Optional, valid only for SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX, TEXTBOX_LIST type)
    - key* string - Key of the option (Included in Create and Response, excluded in Update)
    - label* string - Value of the option
    - url string - URL associated with the option (Optional, valid only for RADIO type)
  - acceptedFormats string (enum: .pdf | .docx | .doc | .jpg | .jpeg | .png | .gif | .csv | .xlsx | .xls | all) - Allowed file formats for uploads. Options include: .pdf, .docx, .doc, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .csv, .xlsx, .xls, all
  - id* string - Unique identifier of the object
  - objectKey* string - The key for your custom / standard object. This key uniquely identifies the custom object. Example: "custom_object.pet" for a custom object related to pets.
  - dataType* string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | RADIO) - Type of field that you are trying to create
  - parentId* string - ID of the parent folder
  - fieldKey* string - Field key. For Custom Object it's formatted as "custom_object.{objectKey}.{fieldKey}". "custom_object" is a fixed prefix, "{objectKey}" is your custom object's identifier, and "{fieldName}" is the unique field name within that object. Example: "custom_object.pet.name" for a "name" field in a "pet" custom object.
  - allowCustomOption boolean - Determines if users can add a custom option value different from the predefined options in records for RADIO type fields. A custom value added in one record does not automatically become an option and will not appear as an option for other records.
  - maxFileLimit number - Maximum file limit for uploads
  - dateAdded* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was added
  - dateUpdated* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was last updated

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

    - channel* string - Creation Channel

  - lastUpdatedBy* object - Last Updated By Meta
    - channel* string - Creation Channel
    - createdAt* string - Created At

### Update Object Schema By Key / Id
PUT /objects/{key}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/objects/{key}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/update-custom-object | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/update-custom-object.md

Update Custom Object Schema  or standard object's like contact, opportunity, business searchable fields. To understand objects and records, please have a look at the documentation here : https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-277156/93bf0c2e23177b0

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: objects/schema.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- key* string (e.g. "custom_objects.pet") - key of the custom or standard object. For custom objects, the key must include the prefix “custom_objects.”. This key can be found on the Object Details page under Settings in the UI.

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateCustomObjectSchemaDTO:
- labels object - This is how your custom object will be displayed
  - singular string (e.g. "Car") - Singular name of the custom object
  - plural string (e.g. "Cars") - Plural name of the custom object
- description string (nullable; e.g. "These are non vaccinated pets") - Pet Object`s description
- locationId* string (e.g. "632c34b4c9b7da3358ac9891") - location id
- searchableProperties* string[] (e.g. ["custom_objects.mad.mad","custom_objects.mad.record_1","custom_objects.mad.nn"]) - Searchable Fields: Provide the field key of your object that you want to search on, using the format (custom_object.<object_name>.<field_key>).

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- object object
  - id* string - id of the custom / standard object schema
  - standard* boolean - false in case of custom objects and true in case of standard objects like contacts and opportunities
  - key* string - key that would be used to refer the custom / standard Object internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). For custom objects, 'custom_objects.' would be added as prefix by default
  - labels* object - This is what your custom / standard object will be called. These labels will be used to display your custom object on the UI
    - singular* string - Singular name of the custom object
    - plural* string - Plural name of the custom object
  - description string - Custom / Standard Object Descriptions for example , Pet Object`s description
  - locationId* string - location's id
  - primaryDisplayProperty* string - Primary property for the custom / standard Object. This would be used as primary data when rendering the UI. 'custom_objects.{{object_key}} or business.{{object_key}} (for company)' would be added as prefix by default for all the custom / standard objects
  - dateAdded* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was added
  - dateUpdated* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was last updated
  - type object - Object`s Type

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Note
PUT /notes/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/notes/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/update-note | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/update-note.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: notes.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- id* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Note Id

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ocQHyuzHvysMo5N5VsXc") - Location Id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateNoteDTO:
- body string (e.g. "lorem ipsum") - The body content of the note
- title string (e.g. "Follow-up summary") - The title of the note
- color string (e.g. "#FFAA00") - The color code of the note
- pinned boolean - Whether the note is pinned

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- note object - The note object
  - id string - Unique identifier for the note
  - body string - The body content of the note
  - userId string - The ID of the user who created the note
  - dateAdded string - The date and time when the note was created
  - contactId string - The ID of the contact associated with the note. Present only when the note is attached to a contact — notes on custom object records are linked through `relations`.
  - businessId string - The ID of the business associated with the note. Present only when the note is attached to a business — notes on custom object records are linked through `relations`.
  - title string - The title of the note
  - color string - The color code of the note
  - pinned boolean - Whether the note is pinned
  - attachments object[] - List of attachments associated with the note
    - id string - Unique identifier for the attachment
    - objectKey string - Object type the note is attached to — a custom object schema key (e.g. "custom_objects.pet"), or a standard object key such as "contact" or "business".
    - recordId string - Id of the record to attach the note to. Available on the Record details page under the 3 dots or in the url.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

For custom objects, the key must include the “custom_objects.” prefix, while standard objects use their respective object keys. This information is available on the Custom Objects Details page under Settings.

- (root) object (free-form object)
